records.title: Outcome-first product surface

content.use_when: A product request is vague or spans multiple screens.
content.practice: State audience, job, desired outcome, constraints, decision authority, and success measure before choosing a visual pattern.
checks: failure and recovery are in scope

records.title: Legacy flat interface baseline

content.practice: Do not recommend as a current default; retain only to explain migration decisions.

records.title: Feature-first hierarchy and authored restraint

content.use_when: A screen feels generic, noisy, or visually unresolved.
content.practice: Establish structure and hierarchy in grayscale, then add type, colour, depth, imagery, and personality as deliberate system choices.
checks: empty and error states are designed

records.title: Readable product type scale

content.use_when: Text density, scanning, or responsive reading is a concern.
content.practice: Choose a contextual scale, then tune weight, line-height, measure, numeric alignment, tracking, and content expansion.

records.title: Semantic colour and state system

content.use_when: A palette must support themes, states, and accessible emphasis.
content.practice: Use semantic roles between primitives and components; pair colour with text, shape, position, or icon and verify every theme.

records.title: Landing page trust-to-action sequence

content.use_when: A landing page must move a visitor toward a clear next action.
content.practice: Sequence promise, relevance, proof, risk reduction, and one dominant next step; remove decorative sections that do not support the decision.

records.title: Decision-led chart story

content.use_when: A chart is being selected or revised for an operational decision.
content.practice: Name audience, action, comparison, and Big Idea before choosing an encoding; use direct labels and a text alternative.

records.title: Observe, fix, and retest loop

content.use_when: A user-facing decision needs behavioural evidence.
content.practice: Use a realistic neutral task, observe without rescuing, separate fact from interpretation, fix the smallest high-impact issue, and repeat the task.
checks: no population claim from a small qualitative sample

records.title: Semantic icon and label pairing

content.use_when: Icons communicate actions, status, or navigation.
content.practice: Validate the import/name, size, stroke and viewBox; classify each icon as labelled or decorative and never hide essential meaning in an icon alone.
checks: accessible name is present where needed

records.title: React stateful accessible component

content.use_when: A React component has multiple interaction states or async work.
content.practice: Model default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, selected, error, and recovery states with semantic DOM and preserved input.

records.title: Web progressive enhancement and responsive resilience

content.use_when: A web flow must remain usable across widths, input modes, and partial failure.
content.practice: Preserve source order, semantic controls, fallback content, keyboard operation, readable reflow, and content variation before adding custom enhancement.

records.title: Licensed font pairing with fallback

content.use_when: A design requests a web font or a new font pairing.
content.practice: Record source, license, language coverage, variable axes, fallback metrics, loading behavior, and the reason the pairing serves the product.
checks: font is not banned by doctrine
loading does not cause layout failure

records.title: Motion with user control and reduced-motion fallback

content.use_when: A motion system or interaction transition is being specified.
content.practice: Use tokenised duration/easing, preserve focus and state announcements, provide a static or shortened reduced-motion path, and avoid unsolicited movement.

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A)

content.do: Give every meaningful image a text alternative; hide decorative images from assistive technology.
content.dont: Leave alt empty on an informative image or describe a decorative flourish.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.1.1 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)

content.do: Body text reaches 4.5:1 against its background; large text reaches 3:1.
content.dont: Set grey body text on a tinted surface without computing the ratio.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.4.3 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text (AA)

content.do: Text scales to 200% without loss of content or function; size text in relative units.
content.dont: Fix heights on text containers so zoomed text clips.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.4.4 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow (AA)

content.do: Content reflows at 320 CSS px width with no two-dimensional scrolling.
content.dont: Force a fixed-width layout that scrolls sideways on a phone.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.4.10 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)

content.do: Component boundaries, focus indicators and meaningful graphics reach 3:1 against adjacent colours.
content.dont: Draw input borders so faint that the field disappears.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.4.11 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing (AA)

content.do: Content survives user overrides of line, paragraph, letter and word spacing.
content.dont: Clip text in fixed-height boxes that break when spacing grows.

evidence.citation: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation, SC 1.4.12 (w3.org/TR/WCAG22/); doctrine/references/wcag-2.2-criteria.md

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus (AA)

content.do: Hover or focus content is dismissible (Escape), hoverable and persistent until dismissed.
content.dont: Show a tooltip that vanishes when the pointer moves onto it.

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)

content.do: Every function works from a keyboard, using native controls where they suffice.

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold (A)

content.do: Nothing flashes more than three times in any one-second period.

records.title: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
